Our story

Small truck.
BIGG heart.

BIGG DOGG is a locally owned family food truck serving made-to-order street eats in Listowel, Ontario.

What started with a love of great food has grown into a local favourite known for crispy-edged smash burgers, freshly battered haddock, loaded fries, poutine and generous portions. Everything is prepared hot, fresh and without cutting corners.

For us, it is about more than filling an order. It is about welcoming people to the truck, serving food we are proud of and giving our community a reason to come back hungry.
